reviews.title: PLEASE READ I ONLY PUT FIVE STARS SO PEOPLE WILL SEE THIS
reviews.text: I was looking for a wallpaper app saw this one read the obviously paid reviews thought they were real and downloaded this. This app is a poor app because it overwhelms users with excessive advertisements and offers a disappointing user experience. Full-screen pop-ups, video ads, and banner adverts appear so frequently that they disrupt the simple act of browsing for wallpapers, making the app slow and unpleasant to use. This heavy reliance on ads clutters the interface and causes delays, which only highlights the limited benefits the app actually provides, as many of the wallpapers are repetitive, low in resolution, or uninspiring. The aggressive monetisation, pushing subscriptions or ad removal purchases, further underlines that the app prioritises revenue over quality. In the end, the constant interruptions, sluggish performance, and lacklustre content combine to make Wallpaper App Micro frustrating rather than enjoyable

reviews.title: Unusable
reviews.text: I just got an iPhone 17 and thought it would be awesome to customize it more that what apple offers as options. I thought I’d start with this app and try a small change, a circular widget that looks like a bat, just to see if I liked it. Well, I’ll never know if I like it because it won’t work. I went through the prompts to make my selection and saved it but on the screen where it should be present, it showed a circle that said “add widget”. I clicked on it and went through the prompts several times, watched all the asinine ads and still nothing. After several failed attempts, deleting and reinstalling restarting my phone, I decided to call it quits and deleted this garbage app.

reviews.title: Misleading
reviews.text: Completely and utterly misleading. I saw an advertisement for this app, and it looked like it was going to change your wallpaper, add some widgets, and change your app icons, all with a simple click of a button. Nope! All they did was add some apps with changed icons onto my screen (not change- add), absolutely nothing with my wallpaper or widgets. I even paid the $4 (per month) subscription to get a nice customization, all just for some apps that I could customize in 20 minutes. Don’t waste your time or money on this, as it’s just a scam and doesn’t change anything.
